item.title: Wheel it up and Make it Glow
item.description:
I’m psyched to be co-leading a workshop at the Steelyard this Spring! It’ll be a hoot, as co-host and friend Dave would say. Speaking of Dave, here’s a picture of his DJing cart.

If you’re in or around Providence, and have any friends who would love to participate in this workshop, please share this post (or even better, the actual landing page) with them! Limited scholarships are also available.

item.title: Three Nights of Lights
item.description:
The big LED matrix I made for Wooly Fair will be made an appearance in downtown Providence this weekend care of the Avenue Concept , as part of the Three Nights of Lights Festival.

We were at 35 Weybosset Street on the evening of 12/1 and on Matthewson Street on the evening of 12/2, as part of the Avenue Concept roster of events.

Lots of amazing art, performance, and smiles on both nights. And of course, plenty of lights!
